newsitem.title: USA: Texas Panhandle cattle trade up $1 at $71 - feedlots.
newsitem.headline: Texas Panhandle cattle trade up $1 at $71 - feedlots.

text.p: Cattle were starting to trade up $1.00 per cwt at $71.00 early Wednesday, compared with a week ago in the Texas Panhandle, feedlot sources said.
Major packers reportedly raised bids to $71.00 and were beginning to buy enough cattle that one feedlot source estimated 50,000 head could trade by the end of the day.
Kansas feedlot sources said they expect $71.00 now that Texas cattle were trading at that level, but could not confirm any sales yet.
Prices were bolstered by tight supplies of market-ready cattle and rising boxed beef prices, sources said.
USDA quoted boxed beef prices up $0.95 to $1.09 late Tuesday, with the price on heavier-weight choice cuts up $1.96 since Friday.
